dsl:
?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe & stacks> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe> | any<global> | any<harmful_aura & inc_damage & stronger> @ boss | pass
{1} ?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(all(enemies).is_boss == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(all(enemies).is_boss == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe & stacks> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe> | any<global> | any<harmful_aura & inc_damage & stronger> @ boss | pass
description: Default support for a team: P2 to P4 of Default Team Duel. In round 1 of a mob fight it attacks. Otherwise it buffs P1 and traps the boss: Mass Feint, Feint, a blade on P1, a mass trap, each that stacks before the same ones that don't, then a global, then a negative aura such as Attenuate on the boss when it beats the aura there, and it passes rather than spend P1's buffs. It never heals or shields; Default Guardian Support does. Once P1 is dead, it attacks.
